rendering_contract.note: Astra 0.7.0 validated large stress builds without perceptible lag; EarthForge may use dense microblocks when they materially improve reconstruction accuracy.

allowed_scopes: roof edges and low-slope roof transitions
architectural curves, diagonals and fine structure
selective interior detail when interiors are authorized
rules: Use full vanilla blocks for bulk mass where micro-resolution adds no evidence-driven value.
Use Astra hosts freely when the source evidence requires sub-block height, curvature, thin geometry, texture or material precision.
Do not impose a fixed host-count budget; validate actual game performance on dense exports.
Keep provenance and confidence separate from rendering capability: better performance does not justify invented detail.
Preserve project registration and orientation across all revisions.
